changes.title: Comparable run cohorts with inspectable evidence
changes.text: Read-only comparable-condition progress and export identify exact earlier and recent cohorts, recorded matching conditions, run identities, UTC date ranges, unknown metrics, exclusions and uncertainty. No causal improvement claim, historical defaulting, scoring change or raw-history rewrite.

changes.title: Verified death context and display harness retained
changes.text: Preserves the previously emulator-accepted TEST313 death-context view and verification receipt. The supplemental Android display harness keeps supported software rendering, native tap alignment and state-driven waiting without altering gameplay or rebuilding the accepted predecessor APK.

changes.title: Cleric Start no longer traps regular alpha players
changes.text: Removes the legacy black-screen Start gate that depended on a developer-only feature file absent from normal player APKs. Both build variants can now start a new Cleric run without changing existing saves, classes, ruleset history or the independently gated lore. New Android real-tap verification explicitly disables private flags and requires reaching the dungeon.

changes.title: Strict core and native verification history
changes.text: Retains the first failed 2080-method core run from an outdated Cleric-block test and its corrected passing 2080-method retest. Requires the complete native matrix with the new Cleric screenshot, previous compiled TEST313 history preserved byte for byte, unchanged signing and application ID, paired developer and player checks, and no automatic release.
